messages:
incident-bot: Paging: P1 - embeddings service degradation detected in us-west-2. Error rate spike >15% for the last 3m. Incident channel #incident-embeddings created. Escalation: on-call ryan-oncall.

ryan-oncall: Ack. I'm on the bridge. Joining now. Can someone drop a concise status update for customers while I triage?

sophia-pd: @ryan-oncall thanks — I'll draft a short status page + a quick CS macro. Will post both here for review. Need ETA?

ryan-oncall: Root cause unknown yet. Initial mitigation: routing to us-east-1 fallback for new requests. No full rollback yet. ETA for first update 10m.

maria-cs: Copy. Drafting two Zendesk reply variants: 1) short acknowledgement for live chats 2) more detailed email macro for impacted accounts. Posting both below — feel free to adapt.

maria-cs: Short chat macro (for Intercom/Zendesk quick reply):

```
Hi — thanks for flagging this. We're aware of increased errors for embeddings in us-west-2 and our on-call engineer is investigating. We may route requests to a fallback region to reduce errors. We'll update you in ~15 minutes with more details. Apologies for the disruption.
Best, Maria (Support)
```

maria-cs: Detailed email macro (for high-touch customers / SLAs):

```
Subject: Incident: Embeddings errors affecting us-west-2 (We’re investigating)

Hello <Customer Name>,

We're reaching out to let you know that we're currently investigating an issue causing failed embedding requests for workloads served from us-west-2. Our on-call and engineering teams are actively troubleshooting.

What we know right now:
- Impact: Increased error rates (>15%) and intermittent failures for embedding generation for some requests originating in us-west-2.
- Mitigation: Traffic is being routed to a fallback region (us-east-1) where possible. Some customers with strict region pinning may still see failures.
- Next update: ~15 minutes or sooner with progress and any targeted workarounds.

If you have a critical workflow that must remain online, reply here and we can help temporarily pin your account to the fallback region or open a dedicated tunnel.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Regards,
Maria 
Customer Success — Redwood Inference
```

ajay-eng: Those read well. A couple of technical points for the update: include whether KV cache invalidations are involved and whether quantized models are affected. From initial logs it looks like a degraded connection to the cache-layer in the us-west-2 cluster.

ajay-eng: Suggested status-page template (short):

```
Status: Investigating
Service: Embeddings (us-west-2)
Impact: Elevated error rates and intermittent failures for embedding requests.
ETA for next update: 15 minutes
Mitigation: Requests being routed to us-east-1 where available.
```

ryan-oncall: Quick internal checklist for support agents handling tickets right now — put this into the agent macro area: 

- Confirm whether customer has region pinning (yes/no).
- If no pinning: advise that requests may be routed to fallback region; instruct to retry after 2 mins.
- If yes (pinned to us-west-2): offer to open a temporary bypass to us-east-1 (requires ops approval).
- Gather request IDs and sample payloads (timestamps, model, seq length) and paste into the thread.
- If customer reports rate-limit-like errors, confirm `429` vs `5xx` and include top 3 error messages.
- Escalate to engineering with `INCID-<thread_ts>` + collected logs.

maria-cs: I'll add that to the ticket UI snippets. Also adding copy for an outbound status page update and a one-liner for support inbox triage.

sophia-pd: For the public status page we should avoid technical jargon; keep it customer-friendly and include mitigation steps. Draft here: 

```
We’re currently investigating issues affecting embeddings requests for customers in the us-west-2 region. Some requests may fail or be slower than normal. Our team has applied routing to a fallback region to reduce customer impact and is continuing to investigate the root cause. We will post another update within 15 minutes.
```

ops-bot: Deploy watch: recent autoscaler deployment 2026-03-15T02:40Z in us-west-2 (deploy-id: autoscaler-2026-03-15-02). Rolling back not recommended without engineer direction. Logs show increased connection drops to internal cache pool 7.

ajay-eng: Adding: please include `workaround: disable prefix/KV cache for affected accounts` as a temporary mitigation for high priority customers — note it will increase token costs.

ryan-oncall: I'm going to attempt to mute chunked requests hitting the failing cache nodes and spin up an emergency sidecar that routes to the healthy pool. ETA 12 mins. If successful, expect error rate to drop.

maria-cs: Customer macros updated in support UI: `embeddings_ack_short`, `embeddings_ack_detailed`, `embeddings_escalate_ops`. I've included placeholders: `<Customer Name>`, `<IncID>`, `<Workaround Steps>`.

sophia-pd: Handoff note for next on-call (copy into the handoff doc):

- Incident ID: INCID-1798501234
- Current state: Investigating. Fallback routing applied. Ops attempting sidecar to healthy KV pool.
- Key contacts: ryan-oncall (on-call), ajay-eng (eng lead), maria-cs (CS lead).
- Customer-facing assets: status.redwood.com/incidents/1798501234 (draft) and updated CS macros in Zendesk.
- Next update scheduled: <+15m from thread_ts>.

ryan-oncall: Update: mitigation in progress — initial sidecar warmed and partial traffic shifted. Error rate dropped ~40% in last 3 mins. Keeping the bridge open.

maria-cs: Notifying top 5 impacted customers via email macro now (using detailed template). Will post copies of outgoing messages here for compliance.

ajay-eng: Noted — will keep monitoring KV pool metrics and will open a focused follow-up PR if we need config changes.

ryan-oncall: If anyone in support receives an angry reply, use this de-escalation snippet: 

```
We hear you — we understand how disruptive this is. Our engineering team has a mitigation in flight and we've routed most traffic to a healthy region. If you need prioritized assistance or region pinning changes, please reply with your account id and I'll escalate immediately.
```

sophia-pd: Great. Marking this thread as the canonical comms source. Please keep updates short and pasteable into the status page / ticket. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Update posted to #incident-embeddings and status.redwood.com (draft). Next automated reminder in 10 minutes.

ryan-oncall: Final for now — reduction in errors sustained ~10 mins. Keeping monitoring window open. If rate goes back up we will reopen bridge. Posting log snippet for oncall handoff:

```
[logs] 2026-03-15T03:12:10Z ERROR cache_conn: connection reset to node-7
[metrics] errors_per_min: 12 -> 3 after sidecar shift
[actions] routed 42% of new traffic to us-east-1 fallback
```

maria-cs: Thanks everyone — I've batched the customer replies and closed urgent routing tickets. Leaving notes on affected accounts to follow up with postmortem actions.

sophia-pd: Handoff ready for next shift. I'll update the incident runbook with the `disable KV cache` temp option and the `sidecar` mitigation steps.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: Monitoring -> Identified (mitigation applied). Recording incident owner: ryan-oncall.

ryan-oncall: Leaving bridge for now. Ping me if things regress. Thanks team.
